rules.justification: Mesh reading: node coordinates are decimal text converted by a correctly rounded strtod (libstdc++ istream) and Rust's f64::from_str is correctly rounded as well, so a correct reader is bit-identical; bounds are min/max of those values. Topology, groups and tags are integers.
rules.evidence: 2026-11-10: accepted by an independent review; 2026-11-11: crates/akantu-io/tests/{mesh_io_fixtures,mesh_io_probe_fixtures}.rs and the Gmsh/Diana reader tests pass bit-identically
rules.reviewed_by: independent review during the port, November 2026
